# Jabra

> Jabra delivers AI-powered professional audio solutions including wireless headsets, speakerphones, video conferencing cameras, and hearing aids for hybrid work and enterprise communication.

Jabra is a Danish manufacturer specializing in workplace audio and communication devices. The company serves enterprise customers, government agencies, and consumers through innovative products featuring noise cancellation, AI voice clarity, and multi-device connectivity across Bluetooth and unified communications platforms.

## Key Topics

- Noise Cancellation
- AI Voice Clarity
- Bluetooth Connectivity
- Hybrid Work Solutions
- Professional Audio
- Evolve3 Series
- Video Conferencing
- Hearing Aids
- Enterprise Solutions
- Zoom & Teams Integration
- Advanced ANC
- Spatial Sound
- Speakerphones
- Webcams
- Auracast Technology

## Office Headsets & Audio

- [Jabra Evolve3 75 | Voice Clarity & On-Ear Comfort for Modern Work](https://www.jabra.com/business/office-headsets/jabra-evolve/jabra-evolve3-75): On-ear headset with AI-enhanced voice clarity and noise cancellation for professional communication
- [Jabra Evolve3 85 | Voice Clarity & Immersive Focus for Modern Work](https://www.jabra.com/business/office-headsets/jabra-evolve/jabra-evolve3-85): Over-ear headset with AI voice clarity and advanced noise cancellation for focused work
- [Office Headsets - Wireless Bluetooth Headsets & Headphones with Mic](https://www.jabra.com/business/office-headsets): Complete Jabra Evolve office headsets collection with noise cancellation and wireless connectivity
- [Bluetooth Conference Speakerphones With Mic | Quality Audio](https://www.jabra.com/business/speakerphones/jabra-speak-series): Jabra Speak Series Bluetooth conference speakerphones with multi-device connectivity and superior audio quality

## Video Conferencing & Cameras

- [Video Conferencing Cameras - 4K HD Camera & Room Systems](https://www.jabra.com/business/video-conferencing/video-conferencing-cameras): Jabra PanaCast 4K video conferencing cameras and room systems optimized for Teams and Zoom
- [Jabra Webcams | Personal Video Cameras](https://www.jabra.com/business/video-conferencing/personal-video-cameras): Jabra PanaCast AI-enabled 4K webcams for home office and meeting room environments

## Hearing Solutions

- [In Store & OTC Hearing Aids with Bluetooth | Behind-the-Ear & Over-the-Ear Hearing Devices](https://www.jabra.com/hearing): Jabra Enhance OTC and prescription hearing aids available at Costco with Bluetooth connectivity
- [Hearing Aid with Bluetooth and Auracast | Jabra Enhance Pro 30](https://www.jabra.com/hearing/enhance-pro-30): Jabra Enhance Pro 30 AI hearing aid featuring Bluetooth and Auracast technology for enhanced hearing
